# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can observe all spell signatures in the area of effect.
@@ 2
Allows the caster to store a single signature for use with other spells on
this list. The caster gains no information about the spell signature in
question, but can recognize it as being distinctly different from other
signatures. A given caster can only have one signature stored per level of
experience.
@@ 3
The caster creates an area with a higher concentration of Essence. One of the
following effects (roll d100, not open-ended) will occur for all spells cast
from within this area for the duration of this spell. The caster may add or
subtract 1 from this roll for every rank he has developed in this spell list.
1-25: spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -10. 26-50: spell durations are
1.5x normal. 51-75: spell areas of effect are 1.5x normal. 76-100: spell
ranges are 1.5x normal.
@@ 4
The caster creates an area with a lower concentration of Essence. One of the
following effects (roll d100, not open-ended) will occur for all spells cast
from within this area for the duration of this spell. The caster may add or
subtract 1 from this roll for every rank he has developed in this spell list.
1-25 spell targets get an RR bonus of +10. 26-50 spell durations are half
normal. 51-75 spell areas of effect are half normal. 76-100 spell ranges are
half normal.
@@ 5
The caster creates an area in which the average amount of available Essence
fluctuates wildly. All spells cast in the area of effect require a Spell
Casting Static Maneuver with a special modification of-15 (even spells that do
not normally need make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver).
@@ 6
The caster creates an area in which average amount of Essence is almost
perfectly uniform. Anytime a Spell Casting Static Maneuver is made in the area
of effect, that maneuver is made with a special modification of+15.
@@ 7
For the duration of this spell, the caster's spells leave no signatures.
@@ 9
As Concentrate Essence I except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25:
spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -20. 26-50: spell durations are 2x
normal. 51-75: spell areas of effect are 2x normal. 76-100: spell ranges are
2x normal.
@@ 10
As Disperse Essence l. except that the random effects are as follows: 1-25
spell targets get an RR bonus of +20. 26-50 spell durations are one quarter
normal. 51-75 spell areas of effect are one quarter normal. 76-100 spell
ranges are one quarter normal.
@@ 11
Caster is able to determine what spell created the target spell signature.
@@ 12
As Destabilize Essence I, except that the modification is -30.
@@ 13
As Stabilize Essence I, except that the modification is +30.
@@ 14
Caster is able to determine the profession and level of the creator of the
target signature.
@@ 15
As Concentrate Essence I except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25:
spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -30. 26-50: spell durations are 3x
normal. 51-75: spell areas of effect are 3x normal. 76-100: spell ranges are
3x normal.
@@ 16
As Disperse Essence l. except that the random effects are as follows: 1-25
spell targets get an RR bonus of +30. 26-50 spell durations are one tenth
normal. 51-75 spell areas of effect are one tenth normal. 76-100 spell ranges
are one tenth normal.
@@ 17
For the duration of this spell, the caster's spells will leave a signature of
his choosing from those he has stored.
@@ 19
As Destabilize Essence I, except that the modification is -45.
@@ 20
As Stabilize Essence I, except that the modification is +45.
@@ 25
Caster learns the name of the creator of the target signature and gains a
mental picture of what he looked like at the time he cast the spell that left
the signature.
@@ 30
As Concentrate Essence I except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25:
spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -40. 26-50: spell durations are 4x
normal. 51-75: spell areas of effect are 4x normal. 76-100: spell ranges are
4x normal.
@@ 50
For the duration, no spell casting is possible within the area of effect.
